name: RSE-Transmog
author: ColonelCousland, RSE contributors
description: Visual-only transmog: pick the look of your head, body, legs, cape and weapons from the appearances your character knows. Opens from the inventory (the RSE-Dock icon, or the Transmog button).

settings.label: Window style
settings.tooltip: native: its own window beside the inventory, in the inventory's frame art, with icon slots and tabs. classic: the original compact list with names, over the inventory grid.

settings.label: Share looks with other players
settings.tooltip: Share your looks with other players who run the mod, and see theirs. Needs the mod on the host or dedicated server too; otherwise looks stay client-side.

settings.label: Show other players' looks
settings.tooltip: Off: always show other players' real gear, even if they share a look.

settings.label: Debug log
settings.tooltip: Extra lines in ue4ss\UE4SS.log (useful for bug reports). Applies at once.
